21037.spot_check: Spot check 2026-10-21 (KBEMS EMS_Agencies_2026-08-01.PDF + agency/county pages). AMR and First Care dropped from the 911 list (no county PSAP, unsourced 911 role). Campbell Fire/Rescue kept on its own licence text ("Campbell County"; NG911 layer 77% of county area), not on AMR/First Care text. Fort Thomas and Central Campbell hold KBEMS 911-response licences (Campbell County Consolidated Dispatch); listed with their verbatim area text. Melbourne Fire District and Wilder Fire are named by the county but hold no KBEMS 911-transport licence.
21037.page_note: Campbell Fire/Rescue is a fire district, not a whole-county provider: the state 911 boundary layer gives it about 77% of the county. Six local districts and agencies split Campbell County between them, and we cannot verify from public records where one ends and the next begins. American Medical Response and First Care Ohio also name the county but have no 911 role we can source, so they are not listed. Melbourne and Wilder fire are named by the county but hold no Board of EMS 911-transport licence.
